thread:
rachel: Quick post-freeze bulletin and a small policy addition around canary health windows. Read if youre owning rollouts this week.
rachel: TL;DR: freeze extended by 4h for weekend runway (2024-08-02T22:00Z -> 2024-08-03T10:00Z). New policy: every canary that touches I/O paths must include a 15m stabilization window where health must be green for >= 90% of the window before next ramp. Also adding a safety reserve: 7% rollback capacity per shard.
deploy-bot: Quiet window updated: start=2024-08-02T22:00:00Z end=2024-08-03T10:00:00Z. Canary health-window policy toggled ON.
ben: Question: what counts as "health green" for stabilization window? Who marks it?
rachel: Health green = no alerts firing for the service, p95 latency within 120% of baseline, error-rate < 0.2% over the 15m window. Canary controller will auto-check these metrics; rollout owner must also add a short note in the PR with the stabilization-check output.
sre-oncall: Incident recap (for context): earlier today a canary spiked due to a misconfigured rate-limit in the API-gateway (ruleset 23). That produced a burst of retries and masked a slow memory growth in loader-svc. We auto-paused the canary and reverted the ruleset. No customer-facing failures, but it exposed we need the stabilization window.
anya: I can add a gate in the deploy pipeline to enforce the 15m check. Would you prefer the pipeline to block automatically or just warn?
rachel: Block automatically. If the stabilization window fails, auto-pause and require manual unpause with a short remediation note and an SRE ack.
kevin: About the 7% rollback reserve: do we need to pre-provision capacity or is a soft-check sufficient?
rachel: Soft-check first: deploy pipeline should calculate current free capacity and fail the canary start if free < 7% per shard. Ops will work on a hard-reservation flag in a follow-up. For now, include the free-capacity output in the PR comment.
sre-oncall: Action items: 1) ops to add the free-capacity verifier to deploy pipeline (anya+kevin) 2) platform to add 15m stabilization gate (anya) 3) owners of any in-flight canaries touching I/O to run the new stabilization script and post results (all owners).
deploy-bot: Canary status: v7.3 = PAUSED (manual) pending stabilization checks. v7.2 = STABLE. Rollback-reserve policy = 7%/shard.
ben: Wheres the stabilization script?
rachel: infra/scripts/stabilization_check.sh. Usage: ./stabilization_check.sh --service <svc> --window 15m --metrics p95,p99,errors. Script exits non-zero on failure; paste output to PR.
anya: I'll push the pipeline gate today and add a short doc in docs/release/gates.md explaining the behavior and how to request exceptions.
kevin: I'll prototype the free-capacity verifier and post the PR link in this thread.
sre-oncall: Monitoring note: added a stabilization dashboard that shows 15m rolling-green % and alerts when rolling-green < 80% for 10m.
rachel: Final: hold non-critical merges affecting I/O until the gate is live. If you need an emergency exception during the extended freeze, use #release-ops with two approvers and include the stabilization mitigation and rollback plan. Thanks everyone. :pray:
